name: nspawn-website
description: nspawn.org: documentation and landing page for nspawn, built with Hugo and Docsy.
author: The nspawn.org team

scripts._update:docsy:post: hugo mod tidy && npm run update:docsy:pack
scripts.approve:hugo: npm approve-scripts hugo-extended && npm run update:docsy:pack
scripts.ci:prepare: npm run _get:docsy && hugo mod graph && hugo mod tidy
scripts.ci:test: npm run ci:prepare && npm run fix:format && npm run test && npm run _diff:check
scripts.seq: bash -c 'for cmd in "$@"; do npm run $cmd || exit 1; done' -
scripts.test-and-fix: npm run fix && npm run test-only
scripts.test-only: npm run check:links && npm run test:site
scripts.update:docsy:main: hugo mod get -u github.com/google/docsy/theme@main && npm run _update:docsy:post
scripts.update:docsy:mod: hugo mod get -u github.com/google/docsy/theme && npm run _update:docsy:post
scripts.update:docsy:pack: hugo mod npm pack && npm pkg set 'name="@docsy/hugoautogen"' private=true --json --prefix packages/hugoautogen && npm install --ignore-scripts
scripts.update:main: npm run update:packages && npm run update:docsy:main
scripts.update: npm run update:packages && npm run update:docsy:mod
